business_summary: Longhua Technology Group Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells heat transfer and energy-saving equipment in China. The company is involved in research, development, production, and sale of new electronic materials and polymer composite materials; and environmental water treatment. It also offers molybdenum and molybdenum alloy sputtering targets, ITO targets, silver alloy targets, tungsten and tungsten alloy targets, and titanium series metal targets for TFT-LCD/AMOLED; ultra-high purity sputtering targets for semiconductor photovoltaic and IC manufacturing; and a series of ultra-high temperature special functional materials that are used in nuclear industry, single-crystal silicon and sapphire manufacturing, medical RT/CT equipment components, high-power IGBT heat dissipation components, high-performance magnetic material preparation, HIP and other vacuum furnace equipment thermal field materials, and other fields. The company also provides structural and functional integrated materials, such as resin composites, rubber and plastic materials, and metal-non-metal composites that are used in rail transit, insulation protection, special vehicles, and shipbuilding materials industries, as well as composite material products; tram products; structural foam materials and their products; thin film absorbing materials; structural foam/blade core material; air coolers, SYL high-efficiency composite coolers, air-cooled islands, direct air-cooled condensing systems, intelligent composite closed-circuit cooling towers, evaporative condensing systems, pressure vessels, and MVR high-efficiency evaporators; industrial water treatment; and tributyl phosphate. In addition, it is involved in hydrometallurgy, rare earth separation, lithium extraction from salt lakes, urban mining resource disposal, battery metal recycling and reuse, and other business. The company also exports its products. Longhua Technology Group Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Luoyang, China.
business_summary_ko: 용화기술그룹유한회사 중국에서 열전달 및 에너지 절약 장비를 제조 및 판매하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 새로운 전자 재료 및 고분자 복합 재료의 연구, 개발, 생산 및 판매에 참여하고 있습니다. 및 환경 수처리. 또한 TFT-LCD/AMOLED용 몰리브덴 및 몰리브덴 합금 스퍼터링 타겟, ITO 타겟, 은 합금 타겟, 텅스텐 및 텅스텐 합금 타겟, 티타늄 시리즈 금속 타겟을 제공합니다. 반도체 광전지 및 IC 제조를 위한 초고순도 스퍼터링 타겟; 원자력 산업, 단결정 실리콘 및 사파이어 제조, 의료용 RT/CT 장비 부품, 고출력 IGBT 방열 부품, 고성능 자성 재료 준비, HIP 및 기타 진공로 장비 열장 재료 및 기타 분야에 사용되는 일련의 초고온 특수 기능성 소재입니다. 또한 철도운송, 단열보호, 특수차량, 조선자재 산업 등에 사용되는 수지복합재, 고무 및 플라스틱 소재, 금속-비금속 복합재 등 구조적, 기능적 일체형 소재를 공급하고 있습니다.
